title: LKKA annual meeting and possible demand for Health Minister Pavļuts’s resignation
scope: One association annual meeting; the reports do not establish whether it was public, in person or online. No street demonstration is reported.
organizer: Latvian Association of Cosmeticians and Cosmetologists (LKKA); LSM says it might act together with the Latvian Beauty Specialists Association (LSSA).
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. No attendance count or denominator is reported. “9,000 registered providers” is workforce context, not turnout; the search-only LETA phrase “most association members” supplies no count.

start_date.summary: LSM published a same-day announcement on Feb. 22 for an LKKA annual meeting at 17:00; a search-only Feb. 22 LETA/TV3 result later says the meeting took place that day. The latter body could not be retrieved.

demands.summary: LSM says the meeting could consider demanding Health Minister Pavļuts’s resignation over beauty-service restrictions; the search-only LETA/TV3 result says most association members supported that demand conditionally.

organizer.summary: LKKA is named as the meeting organizer; LSM says a related association might join the demand.

location.summary: Unknown; neither item reports where the meeting was held.

scope.summary: Reported as an annual association meeting, not a street action. Public access and meeting mode are not reported.

participants_original.summary: No attendance is reported. “Most association members” is a search-only qualitative claim without a count; 9,000 is a registered provider workforce figure.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No evidence establishes 50 people at the same time or public access.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; available material does not establish a protest gathering.

state_response.summary: Unknown; available material does not establish a protest gathering or state response.

notes: Retained only as an unresolved meeting lead. S012 is an opened LSM announcement published before the meeting; it reports that LKKA planned to consider the demand but gives no result. S013 is a search-only LETA/TV3 item saying the meeting occurred and most association members supported the conditional demand; its body was not retrieved and it is not independent confirmation of other LETA reports. This is not established as a public protest. No turnout can be inferred from the affected-industry headcount.
open_questions: Did the annual meeting occur in person, and where?
Was it open to the public or otherwise a public gathering?
Was the resignation demand formally made or transmitted?
Did any separate public demonstration occur?
